name: Coveralls API
tagline: REST API for coverage jobs, repos, and badge data from Coveralls
description: Coveralls is a coverage reporting service used with CI. Its REST API exposes jobs, repositories, and badge-related data so tools can submit coverage, inspect build status, and pull repo metrics. Auth is typically token-based for CI integrations and account access.

auth.details: Repo/token or account API token via Authorization header or form params; self-serve signup
